description:
The concrete `CheckExecutor` for the MVP: shell out to the Claude Code CLI via `claude -p` with the assembled prompt/instructions, the `haiku` model family, and `--mcp-config` pointing at this check's dedicated endpoint (payload from M4). Run with the sandbox directory (M3) as the working directory; capture exit status/stderr into an `AgentOutcome`.
